# TESS Program G09196

Title: Pulsating Eclipsing Binaries From TESS: Precision Stellar Parameters And Asteroseismic Diagnostics

PI: Pawar, Tilaksingh - Villanova University

Type: SMALL

Summary: Eclipsing binaries with pulsating components offer a unique opportunity for stellar astrophysics, providing masses, radii, and asteroseismic probes of the interior in a single system. We propose 120-second cadence observations of more than 350 systems identified from TESS FFI data within the classical instability strip, all of which will have radial velocities from Gaia DR4. Improved cadence will resolve eclipse morphology and eliminate aliasing, while multi-sector coverage will extend the temporal baseline needed to resolve closely spaced frequencies. These results will serve as a valuable resource for testing stellar evolution models and tidal interaction theory.
